# ha_tool CLI protocol (version 1)

ha_tool CLI protocol. Commands are text lines; replies and events are OK/ERR/EVT lines (proto text) or JSON Lines (proto json). Every event also carries t (ms since boot).

Types: `int` decimal integer, `float` decimal number, `bool` 0 or 1, `str` text; quoted if it contains spaces, `addr` AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF/random|public, `hex` 0x hexadecimal, `enum` one of values.

## Commands

### `bonding create [<name>] [addr=] [io=]`

New identity (address, IRK, keys), RAM only; the name is the tester's handle

Mode: `unicast`

| Argument | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name (positional)` | str | unique, not only digits (default identity<id>); optional |
| `addr=` | addr | static random identity address (default: generated) |
| `io=` | enum | none\|display\|yesno\|keyboard\|kbd_display |

Reply: `id` (int), `name` (str), `addr` (addr), `io` (str)

### `bonding list`

All identities with connection, device, security and bond

Mode: `unicast`

Reply: `count` (int)

Data `IDENTITY`: `id` (int), `name` (str), `addr` (addr), `io` (str), `connection` (str), `device` (addr), `device_name` (str), `security` (str), `bond` (str), `bonds` (int), `source` (bool)

|---|---|---|
| `identity (positional)` | str | identity name or id |

Reply: `id` (int), `name` (str), `addr` (addr), `io` (str), `connection` (str), `device` (addr), `device_name` (str), `security` (str), `bond` (str), `bonds` (int), `source` (bool), `rssi` (int, optional), `interval_us` (int, optional), `latency` (int, optional), `sto_ms` (int, optional), `phy` (str, optional)

|---|---|---|

Reply: `count` (int)

### `bonding connect <identity> [address=] [bluetooth-name=] [scan=] [timeout=] [interval=] [latency=] [sto=]`

Connect as this identity, to an address or a Bluetooth name (result: bonding_connected / bonding_connect_failed). Pairing is a separate step

Mode: `unicast`

| Argument | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `identity (positional)` | str | identity name or id |
| `address=` | addr | device to connect to |
| `bluetooth-name=` | str | or the Bluetooth name it advertises (exactly one device must answer) |
| `scan=` | int | ms; scan for the name (default 2000) |
| `timeout=` | int | ms |
| `interval=` | int | ms |
| `latency=` | int |  |
| `sto=` | int | ms |

Reply: `id` (int), `state` (str), `device` (addr), `device_name` (str)

Data `DEVICE`: `addr` (addr), `name` (str), `rssi` (int)
